title.zh: 卷三 本紀第三 太祖三
title.raw: 卷三 本紀第三 太祖三 Volume 3 Annals 3: Taizu 3

sentences.zh: 太祖三

translations.literal: Taizu III.
translations.idiomatic: Annals of Taizu, continued.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月壬辰朔，雨雪，不御殿。

translations.literal: In year five, spring, first month, on renchen, the new-moon day, rain and snow fell; he did not hold audience in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaibao year five, on the renchen new moon in the first month of spring, snow mixed with rain, and he withheld court audience.

sentences.zh: 禁鐵鑄浮屠及佛像。

translations.literal: Iron was forbidden for casting stupas and Buddha images.
translations.idiomatic: He banned the use of iron to cast pagodas and Buddha statues.

sentences.zh: 庚子，前盧氏縣尉鄢陵許永年七十有五，自言父瓊年九十九，兩兄皆八十餘，乞一官以便養。

translations.literal: On gengzi, former Lushi county adjutant Xu Yong of Yanling, age seventy-five, stated that his father Qiong was ninety-nine and both elder brothers were over eighty, and begged an office so as to support them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Xu Yong, a seventy-five-year-old former adjutant from Lushi now living in Yanling, reported that his father Qiong was ninety-nine and both brothers past eighty, and asked for a post so he could provide for them.

sentences.zh: 因召瓊厚賜之，授永鄢陵令。

translations.literal: Thereupon Qiong was summoned and richly rewarded; Yong was appointed magistrate of Yanling.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned Qiong, lavished gifts on him, and made Yong magistrate of Yanling.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，省州縣小吏及直力人。

translations.literal: On renyin, petty clerks of prefectures and counties and hired laborers were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he cut back county and prefectural junior clerks and day laborers on the payroll.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，罷襄州歲貢魚。

translations.literal: On yisi, Xiang prefecture's annual tribute of fish was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he ended Xiangzhou's yearly fish tribute to court.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子，詔沿河十七州各置河隄判官一員。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingzi, an edict ordered that along the river seventeen prefectures each establish one river-embankment investigating commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingzi, he decreed one dike inspector for each of the seventeen prefectures along the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以鳳州七房銀冶為開寶監。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Qifang silver works of Feng prefecture were made the Kaibao Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he reorganized Fengzhou's Qifang silver smelters as the Kaibao Directorate.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以兵部侍郎劉熙古參知政事。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Vice Minister of War Liu Xigu was made participant in governance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he named Vice Minister Liu Xigu a chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬辰，禮部試進士安守亮等諸科共三十八人，召對講武殿，始放榜。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on renchen, the Ministry of Rites examined presented scholars An Shouliang and others of various subjects totaling thirty-eight persons; they were summoned for audience at Lecture-on-Military-Affairs Hall, and the roster was released for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on renchen, thirty-eight candidates including jinshi An Shouliang passed the Ministry of Rites exams, faced the emperor in Lecture Hall, and saw the first published rankings.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，升密州為安化軍節度。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Mizhou was elevated to Anhua Army circuit commission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he raised Mizhou to Anhua Army commandery status.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，賜潁州龍騎指揮使仇興及兵士錢。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengwu, Longqi Brigade commander Qiu Xing of Ying prefecture and the soldiers were given money.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengwu, he rewarded Yingzhou's Dragon Cavalry commander Qiu Xing and his men with cash.

sentences.zh: 辛未，占城國王波美稅遣使來獻方物。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the king of Champa, Bo Meishui, sent envoys to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Champa king Bo Meishui dispatched envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸教船池習戰。

translations.literal: On renshen, he visited the Boat-Training Pool to practice warfare.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he went to the Boat-Training Pool for naval drills.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，殿中侍御史張穆坐贓棄市。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Censor-in-chief Zhang Mu, for corruption, was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou palace censor Zhang Mu was put to death in the market for graft.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅朔，三佛齊國主釋利烏耶遣使來獻方物。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on gengyin, the new-moon day, the lord of Srivijaya, Shili Wuye, sent envoys to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon in the fourth month of summer, the Srivijayan ruler Shili Wuye sent tribute bearers to court.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣使檢視水災田。

translations.literal: On bingwu, envoys were dispatched to inspect flood-damaged fields.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he sent commissioners to survey cropland ruined by the floods.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣使諸州捕虎。

translations.literal: On bingyin, envoys were dispatched to the various prefectures to capture tigers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he ordered agents in every prefecture to hunt tigers.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，賜恩赦侯劉鋹錢一百五十萬。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengshen, the Marquis Who Received Amnesty Liu Chang was given one million five hundred thousand in money.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengshen, he granted pardoned marquis Liu Chang 1.5 million cash.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命近臣祈晴。

translations.literal: On yichou, close officials were ordered to pray for clear weather.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he told his inner circle to pray for fair skies.

sentences.zh: 併廣南州十三、縣三十九。

translations.literal: In Lingnan southward, thirteen prefectures and thirty-nine counties were merged.
translations.idiomatic: The court consolidated thirteen prefectures and thirty-nine counties in southern Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，罷嶺南採珠媚川都卒為靜江軍。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Lingnan pearl-gathering Meichuan command was abolished, and the troops were made the Jingjiang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he dissolved the Meichuan pearl-fleet command in Lingnan and re-formed its men as the Jingjiang Army.

sentences.zh: 辛未，河決濮陽，命潁州團練使曹翰往塞之。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the river burst its banks at Puyang; Yingzhou training commissioner Cao Han was ordered to go block it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Yellow River broke through at Puyang, and he sent Yingzhou commissioner Cao Han to stem the breach.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以霖雨，出後宮五十餘人，賜予以遣之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, because of incessant rain, more than fifty women of the inner palace were released, given gifts, and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, citing the endless rains, he dismissed over fifty palace women with gifts and sent them home.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，河南、北淫雨，澶、滑、濟、鄆、曹、濮六州大水。

translations.literal: On dinghai, incessant rain fell north and south of the Yellow River; the six prefectures Chao, Hua, Ji, Yan, Cao, and Pu suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai torrential rains on both banks of the Yellow River inundated Chao, Hua, Ji, Yan, Cao, and Pu.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，河決陽武，汴決穀熟。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jichou, the river broke at Yangwu; the Bian River broke at Gushu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jichou, the Yellow River breached at Yangwu and the Bian Canal at Gushu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔：淫雨河決，沿河民田有為水害者，有司具聞除租。

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict stated: because of incessant rain and river breaks, wherever commoners' fields along the river suffered flood harm, the responsible offices should report in full and remit rent.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he decreed that officials along the river must report flooded fields and cancel their tax assessments.

sentences.zh: 戊申，修陽武隄。

translations.literal: On wushen, the Yangwu embankment was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen work crews rebuilt the Yangwu dikes.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，右拾遺張恂坐贓棄市。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiwei, Right Reminder Zhang Xun, for corruption, was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiwei, remonstrance official Zhang Xun was executed in the market for taking bribes.

sentences.zh: 癸未，邕、容等州獠人作亂。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the Liao people of Yong, Rong, and other prefectures rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the Liao tribes of Yongzhou, Rongzhou, and neighboring districts rebelled.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，高麗國王王昭遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengyin, the king of Goryeo, Wang Zhao, sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengyin, Goryeo's King Wang Zhao sent tribute envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 己亥，廣州行營都監朱憲大破獠賊於容州。

translations.literal: On jihai, Guangzhou mobile-camp chief inspector Zhu Xian greatly defeated Liao bandits at Rong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Zhu Xian, chief inspector of the Guangzhou field headquarters, routed the Liao rebels at Rongzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，升宿州為保靜軍節度，罷密州仍為防禦。

translations.literal: On guimao, Suzhou was elevated to Baojing Army circuit commission; Mizhou was abolished as circuit and again made defense command.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he raised Suzhou to Baojing Army circuit status and demoted Mizhou back to a defense prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingsi, the new-moon day, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi new moon in the ninth month a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，李崇矩以鎮國軍節度使罷。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Li Chongju was dismissed as Military Commissioner of Zhenguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Chongju was removed as circuit commissioner of Zhenguo Army.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，幸河陽節度使張仁超第視疾。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on gengzi, he visited the residence of Heyang military commissioner Zhang Renchao to see him in illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengzi, he called at Heyang commissioner Zhang Renchao's home to inquire after his health.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，試道流，不才者勒歸俗。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Daoist clergy were examined; those without talent were compelled to return to lay life.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he tested Daoist priests and forced the unqualified back into secular life.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，李繼明、藥繼清大破獠賊於英州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiwei, Li Jiming and Yao Jiqing greatly defeated Liao bandits at Ying prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiwei, Li Jiming and Yao Jiqing crushed the Liao rebels at Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，禁僧道習天文地理。

translations.literal: On guihai, monks and Daoists were forbidden to study astronomy and geography.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he barred Buddhist and Daoist clerics from learning astronomy or geomancy.

sentences.zh: 己巳，禁舉人寄應。

translations.literal: On jisi, presented scholars' fraudulent registration in distant examinations was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he outlawed candidates sitting for exams outside their home circuits.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命參知政事薛居正、呂餘慶兼淮、湖、嶺、蜀轉運使。

translations.literal: On gengchen, participant councilors Xue Juzheng and Lü Yuqing were ordered concurrently to serve as transport commissioners for Huai, Hu, Ling, and Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he charged chief councilors Xue Juzheng and Lü Yuqing to double as transport commissioners for the Huai, lake, Lingnan, and Shu circuits.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉朔，祈雪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yiyou, the new-moon day, snow was prayed for.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon in the twelfth month he held rites praying for snow.

sentences.zh: 己亥，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On jihai, he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he hunted in the outskirts near the capital.

sentences.zh: 開封尹光義暴疾，遂如其第視之。

translations.literal: Kaifeng intendant Guangyi suffered a sudden violent illness; forthwith he went to his residence to see him.
translations.idiomatic: When Kaifeng intendant Liu Guangyi fell suddenly ill, the emperor went straight to his house to visit him.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，內班董延諤坐監務盜芻粟，杖殺之。

translations.literal: On jiayin, inner attendants corps member Dong Yan'e, for supervising duties and stealing fodder grain, was beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin palace guardsman Dong Yan'e was beaten to death for embezzling fodder while overseeing the stores.

sentences.zh: 詔合入令錄者引見後方注。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that those qualified for magistrate and registrar posts be presented at audience before registration.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that candidates for county magistrate and registrar must face the throne before their appointments could be recorded.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大雨雪。

translations.literal: On yimao, great rain and snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao a heavy snowstorm swept the capital.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大饑。

translations.literal: That year, great famine.
translations.idiomatic: Famine ravaged the realm that year.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月丙辰朔，不御殿。

translations.literal: In year six, spring, first month, on bingchen, the new-moon day, he did not hold audience in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaibao year six, on the bingchen new moon in the first month of spring, he again withheld court audience.

sentences.zh: 置蜀水陸轉運計度使。

translations.literal: He established a Shu water-and-land transport planning commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He created the office of Commissioner for Planning Shu Combined Water-and-Land Transport.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，修魏縣河。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the river at Wei County was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou work was ordered on the river at Wei County.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌朔，棣州兵馬監押、殿直傅延翰謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the bingxu new moon, Di prefecture military inspector and palace attendant Fu Yanhan plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon in the second month, Fu Yanhan, military inspector at Di and palace attendant, was put to death for treason.

sentences.zh: 丙申，曹州饑，漕太倉米二萬石振之。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Cao prefecture suffered famine; twenty thousand shi of grain from the Taicang granary were transported to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen famine struck Cao; twenty thousand shi of imperial granary grain were shipped in relief.

sentences.zh: 己亥，吳越國進銀裝花舫、金香師子。

translations.literal: On jihai, the state of Wuyue presented a silver-mounted flower boat and gold incense lions.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Wuyue sent a silver-trimmed pleasure barge and gold lion censers for incense.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯朔，周鄭王殂於房州，上素服發哀，輟朝十日，諡曰恭帝，命還葬慶陵之側，陵曰順陵。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the yimao new moon, the Zhou Prince of Zheng died at Fangzhou; the emperor wore plain mourning garb and expressed grief, suspended court for ten days, gave the posthumous title Respectful Emperor, and ordered him reburied beside Qingling in a tomb called Shunling.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao new moon in the third month the last Zhou emperor, the Prince of Zheng, died in exile at Fangzhou; Taizu mourned in undyed robes, closed court for ten days, styled him Emperor Gong, and had him interred beside Qingling at Shunling.

sentences.zh: 己未，復密州為安化軍節度。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Mi prefecture was again made the Anhua Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Mi was restored as the seat of the Anhua Army command.

sentences.zh: 庚申，覆試進士於講武殿，賜宋準及下第徐士廉等諸科百二十七人及第。

translations.literal: On gengshen, jinshi candidates were re-examined at the Lecture Hall for Military Affairs; Song Zhun and the failed candidate Xu Shilian, together with one hundred twenty-seven men from other subjects, were granted passage.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the court held a supplemental jinshi examination in the Lecture Hall for Military Affairs, passing one hundred twenty-seven candidates from every track, including Song Zhun and Xu Shilian, who had failed the first round.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賜宋準等宴錢二十萬。

translations.literal: On yihai, Song Zhun and the others were granted two hundred thousand in banquet funds.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he awarded Song Zhun and his cohort two hundred thousand cash for their celebration feast.

sentences.zh: 大食國遣使來獻。

translations.literal: The state of Dashi sent envoys to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Arabia dispatched envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士、知貢舉李昉坐試人失當，責授太常少卿。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician and chief examiner Li Fang, for improper selection of candidates, was demoted to Vice Director of Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fang of the Hanlin Academy, who had overseen the examinations, was reduced to Vice Director of Ceremonial for mishandling the lists.

sentences.zh: 試朝臣死王事者子陸坦等，賜進士出身。

translations.literal: The sons of court officials who had died in the ruler's service, such as Lu Tan, were examined and granted jinshi status.
translations.idiomatic: He tested the sons of officials who had died on imperial business—Lu Tan among them—and awarded them jinshi standing.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸相國寺觀新修塔。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he visited Xiangguo Temple to view the newly repaired pagoda.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he went to Xiangguo Temple to inspect its newly rebuilt stupa.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，召開封尹光義、天平軍節度使石守信等賞花習射於苑中。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on dinghai, he summoned Kaifeng chief Guangyi, Taiping military commissioner Shi Shouxin, and others to enjoy flowers and practice archery in the park.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on dinghai in the fourth month, he called Guangyi of Kaifeng, Shi Shouxin of Taiping, and other intimates to the imperial park for flower viewing and archery.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣盧多遜為江南國信使。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Lu Duoxun was dispatched as envoy to Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he sent Lu Duoxun as credentialed envoy to the Jiangnan state.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，占城國王悉利陀盤印茶遣使來獻方物。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the king of Champa, Cili Tuoban Yicha, sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen King Cili Tuoban Yicha of Champa sent envoys with regional gifts.

sentences.zh: 丙午，黎州保塞蠻來歸。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Baosai tribes of Lizhou came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Baosai clans of Lizhou pledged allegiance.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔修五代史。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict ordered compilation of the History of the Five Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he ordered the court to compile the History of the Five Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，劉熙古以戶部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengshen, Liu Xigu retired as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengshen, Liu Xigu resigned his post as Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 詔：中書吏擅權多姦贓，兼用流內州縣官。

translations.literal: An edict stated: Secretariat clerks have monopolized power and are often corrupt; officials drawn from the internal transfer rolls of prefectures and counties shall also be employed.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that because Secretariat clerks had grown overmighty and venal, posts should be shared with officials rotated up from the prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 己巳，交州丁璉遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On jisi, Ding Lian of Jiaozhou sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Ding Lian of Jiaozhou sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 幸玉津園觀刈麥。

translations.literal: He visited Yujin Garden to watch the wheat harvest.
translations.idiomatic: He went to Yujin Garden to observe the reaping of wheat.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，殺右拾遺馬適。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the Right Reminder Ma Shi was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he had Right Reminder Ma Shi put to death.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，閱在京百司吏，黜為農者四百人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinmao, clerks of the capital bureaus were reviewed; four hundred were dismissed to farming.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinmao, he inspected the capital bureaucracy and sent four hundred clerks back to the fields.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，占城國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On guisi, Champa sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Champa again sent envoys with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 隰州巡檢使李謙溥拔北漢七砦。

translations.literal: Xi prefecture patrol commissioner Li Qianpu captured seven fortresses of Northern Han.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qianpu, patrol commissioner of Xi, seized seven Northern Han strongholds.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，雷有鄰告宰相趙普黨堂吏胡贊等不法，贊及李可度並杖、籍沒。

translations.literal: On guimao, Lei Youlin reported that Chancellor Zhao Pu's faction clerk Hu Zan and others had acted unlawfully; Zan and Li Kedou were both flogged and their property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Lei Youlin accused Chancellor Zhao Pu's chief clerk Hu Zan and his circle of corruption; Zan and Li Kedou were beaten and their estates seized.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔參知政事與宰相趙普分知印押班奏事。

translations.literal: On gengxu, an edict ordered the Vice Grand Councilors and Chancellor Zhao Pu to divide custody of the seals, lead the court sessions in rotation, and report affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he directed the vice grand councilors and Zhao Pu to share seal duty, preside over audiences in turn, and present business jointly.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子朔，詔諸州府置司寇參軍，以進士、明經者為之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the renzi new moon, an edict ordered every prefecture and superior command to establish a Criminal Affairs adjutant, to be filled by jinshi and classics graduates.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon in the seventh month of autumn he required each prefecture to appoint a Criminal Affairs adjutant drawn from jinshi and classics licentiates.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，減廣南無名率錢。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the unnamed surcharge levies of Guangnan were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he cut the miscellaneous unnamed levies in Guangnan.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，罷成都府偽蜀嫁裝稅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yiyou, the former Shu bridal-trousseau tax at Chengdu was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou, he ended the Chengdu levy on bridal dowries left over from the Shu regime.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賜布衣王澤方同學究出身。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the commoner Wang Zefang was granted standing equal to a classics licentiate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he honored the scholar Wang Zefang with status equal to a classics licentiate.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，泗州推官侯濟坐試判假手，杖、除名。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Sizhou investigating officer Hou Ji, for having his examination judgment written by another, was flogged and struck from the register.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Hou Ji, investigating officer of Sizhou, was beaten and expelled for submitting a proxy essay in the judgment examination.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，趙普罷為河陽三城節度使、同平章事。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Zhao Pu was dismissed and made military commissioner of the Three Cities of Heyang with the title Associate Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhao Pu left the capital chancellorship for the Three Cities of Heyang command, retaining the honorary title of grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，幸都亭驛。

translations.literal: On xinyou, he visited Duting Post Station.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he went out to Duting Post Station.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，餘慶以尚書左丞罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingmao, Yu Qing was dismissed as Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingmao, Yu Qing was removed as Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己巳，封光義為晉王、兼侍中，德昭同中書門下平章事，薛居正為門下侍郎、同平章政事，戶部侍郎、樞密副使沈義倫為中書侍郎、同平章事，石守信兼侍中，盧多遜中書舍人、參知政事。

translations.literal: On jisi, Guangyi was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin with concurrent Palace Attendant; Dezhao as Associate Grand Councilor; Xue Juzheng as Vice Director of the Chancellery and Associate Grand Councilor; Shen Yilun, Vice Minister of Revenue and Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs, as Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Grand Councilor; Shi Shouxin with concurrent Palace Attendant; and Lu Duoxun as Secretariat Drafting Officer and Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he made Guangyi Prince of Jin and Palace Attendant, named Dezhao associate grand councilor, promoted Xue Juzheng to vice director of the Chancellery with full councilor rank, elevated Shen Yilun from revenue and the Bureau of Military Affairs to vice director of the Secretariat with councilor rank, added Palace Attendant to Shi Shouxin's titles, and restored Lu Duoxun as drafting officer and vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔晉王光義班宰相上。

translations.literal: On renshen, an edict placed Prince of Jin Guangyi's court rank above the grand councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he decreed that Prince of Jin Guangyi would take precedence over the chancellors in court order.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，葬周恭帝，不視朝。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiashen, the Zhou Respectful Emperor was buried; the emperor did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on jiashen in the tenth month, he buried Emperor Gong of Zhou and suspended audience for the day.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸玉津園觀稼。

translations.literal: On dinghai, he visited Yujin Garden to view the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he went to Yujin Garden to inspect the harvest.

sentences.zh: 戊子，流星出文昌、北斗。

translations.literal: On wuzi, a meteor appeared from the Wenchang and Beidou asterisms.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi a shooting star streaked out from Wenchang toward the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，特赦諸官吏姦贓。

translations.literal: On jiachen, a special amnesty was granted for officials' corruption.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he proclaimed a limited pardon for official graft.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，詔常參官進士及第者各舉文學一人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guichou, an edict ordered every regular attendee who had passed the jinshi examination to recommend one man of literary talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guichou, he required each jinshi among the regular court attendees to nominate one literary scholar.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，命近臣祈雪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renwu, close ministers were ordered to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renwu, he sent his inner circle to conduct snow prayers.

sentences.zh: 丙午，前中書舍人、參知政事多遜起復視事。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the former Secretariat Drafting Officer and Vice Grand Councilor Duoxun was restored and resumed office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Lu Duoxun, lately drafting officer and vice grand councilor, was recalled from leave and returned to duty.

sentences.zh: 行開寶通禮。

translations.literal: The Kaibao Comprehensive Rituals were put into effect.
translations.idiomatic: The court began enforcing the Kaibao Comprehensive Rituals.

sentences.zh: 限度僧法，諸州僧帳及百人歲許度一人。

translations.literal: A law limiting ordination of monks: in each prefecture, for every hundred names on the monastic register, one ordination per year was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He capped monastic ordinations so that each prefecture might tonsure only one monk a year for every hundred already on its rolls.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月庚戌，不御殿。

translations.literal: In year seven, spring, the first month, on gengxu, he did not preside in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaibao year seven, on gengxu in the first month of spring, he withheld court audience.

sentences.zh: 庚申，占城國王波美稅遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the king of Champa, Bo Meishui, sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen King Bo Meishui of Champa sent envoys with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 齊州野蠶成繭。

translations.literal: At Qizhou, wild silkworms formed cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: In Qizhou wild silkworms spun cocoons.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，左拾遺秦亶、太子中允呂鵠並坐贓，宥死，杖、除名。

translations.literal: On guihai, Left Remonstrator Qin Chang and Crown Prince's Court Officer Lü E were both convicted of graft; death was spared; they were flogged and struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Qin Chang, left remonstrator, and Lü E, an associate in the heir's household, were found guilty of corruption; their lives were spared, but they were beaten and expelled from office.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengchen, the new-moon day, the sun suffered an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon in the second month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，日有二黑子。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the sun showed two black spots.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu two sunspots were observed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命近臣祈雨。

translations.literal: On guimao, close ministers were ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he sent his inner circle to conduct rain prayers.

sentences.zh: 詔：詩、書、易三經學究，依三經、三傳資敘入官。

translations.literal: An edict: classicists in the three classics of Poetry, Documents, and Changes were to enter office with qualification grading according to the Three Classics and Three Commentaries.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that scholars credentialed in Poetry, Documents, and Changes alone should receive the same civil-service standing as men who had passed the Three Classics and Three Commentaries examinations.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太子中舍胡德沖坐隱官錢，棄市。

translations.literal: On yisi, Crown Prince's Court Officer Hu Dechong, for concealing official funds, was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Hu Dechong, an officer in the heir's household, was put to death in the market for embezzling public money.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，三佛齊國王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yichou, the king of Sanfoqi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yichou, the king of Srivijaya sent envoys with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午，遣使檢嶺南民田。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on bingwu, envoys were dispatched to inspect civilian fields in Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingwu, he sent commissioners to survey peasant holdings in Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申朔，殿中侍御史李瑩坐受南唐饋遺，責授右讚善大夫。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wushen, the new-moon day, Palace Censor Li Ying, for accepting gifts from Southern Tang, was demoted to Right Supporter of the Heir.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen new moon in the fifth month, censor Li Ying was reduced to a tutoring post in the heir's palace for taking Southern Tang presents.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以布衣齊得一為章丘主簿。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the commoner Qi Deyi was appointed principal clerk of Zhangqiu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he named the scholar Qi Deyi chief clerk of Zhangqiu.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔市二價者以枉法論。

translations.literal: An edict: those who sold at two prices were to be prosecuted as bending the law.
translations.idiomatic: He ruled that merchants who charged two prices for the same goods would be tried for corruption of the law.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幸講武池觀習水戰。

translations.literal: On bingyin, he visited the Lecture-on-Military-Affairs Pool to watch naval drill.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he went to the Boat-Training Pool to inspect fleet exercises.

sentences.zh: 丙子，又幸講武池，遂幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he again visited the Lecture Pool, then visited Yujin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he returned to the training pool and afterward strolled Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，河中府饑，發粟三萬石振之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingshen, Hezhong circuit suffered famine; thirty thousand shi of grain were issued to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingshen, famine struck Hezhong; the court released thirty thousand shi of grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 己亥，淮溢入泗州城；

translations.literal: On jihai, the Huai overflowed into Suzhou city;
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Huai River poured into the city of Suzhou;

sentences.zh: 壬寅，安陽河溢，皆壞民居。

translations.literal: On renyin, the Anyang River overflowed; in both cases commoners' dwellings were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: on renyin the Anyang burst its banks—together the floods wrecked countless homes.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，幸講武池觀習水戰，遂幸玉津園。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on renzi, he visited the Lecture Pool to watch naval drill, then visited Yujin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renzi, he reviewed naval maneuvers at the training pool and then went on to Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，南丹州溪洞酋帥莫洪燕內附。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the cave chieftain Mo Hongyan of Nandanzhou submitted in allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Mo Hongyan, a tribal leader in the Nandanzhou hill country, came in to the court.

sentences.zh: 詔減成都府鹽錢。

translations.literal: An edict reduced the salt levy of Chengdu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He cut the salt tax charged in Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太子中允李仁友坐不法，棄市。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Crown Prince's Court Officer Li Renyou, for unlawful conduct, was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Li Renyou, an associate in the heir's household, was executed in the market for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，吳越國王遣使來朝貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuyin, the king of Wuyue sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuyin, the king of Wuyue dispatched envoys to present tribute at court.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，諭吳越伐江南。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Wuyue was instructed to attack Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he ordered Wuyue to march against Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，陳州貢芝草，一本四十九莖。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Chenzhou presented spirit fungus; one plant bore forty-nine stems.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Chenzhou sent a miraculous fungus to court—a single stalk with forty-nine branches.

sentences.zh: 己丑，幸講武池，賜習水戰軍士錢。

translations.literal: On jichou, he visited the Lecture Pool and bestowed money on soldiers drilling in naval warfare.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he watched fleet drill at the training pool and rewarded the sailors with cash.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，殿中丞趙象坐擅稅，除名。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Palace Aide Zhao Xiang, for levying unauthorized taxes, was struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu palace aide Zhao Xiang was expelled from office for collecting taxes on his own authority.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸講武池，觀習水戰，遂幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On jiachen, he visited the Lecture Pool, watched naval drill, then visited Yujin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he inspected naval exercises at the training pool and then went to Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，命宣徽南院使、義成軍節度使曹彬為西南路行營馬步軍戰櫂都部署，山南東道節度使潘美為都監，潁州團練使曹翰為先鋒都指揮使，將兵十萬出荊南，以伐江南。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guihai, Palace Commissioner of the Southern Inner Court and Yicheng Army military commissioner Cao Bin was made overall commander of horse, foot, and war-fleet forces of the Southwest Route Field Headquarters; Shannan East Circuit military commissioner Pan Mei was made chief supervisor; Yingzhou training commissioner Cao Han was made vanguard commander-in-chief; he led one hundred thousand troops out from Jingnan to attack Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guihai, Cao Bin—commissioner of the southern inner palace and military governor of Yicheng—was named supreme commander of the Southwest expedition's land and river forces, with Pan Mei of Shannan East as his deputy and Cao Han of Yingzhou as vanguard chief; one hundred thousand men marched out of Jingnan to bring down Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 將行，召曹彬、潘美，戒之曰：「城陷之日，慎無殺戮；

translations.literal: As they were about to depart, he summoned Cao Bin and Pan Mei and admonished them, saying: "On the day the city falls, take care not to slaughter;
translations.idiomatic: Before they left he called in Cao Bin and Pan Mei and warned them: "When the walls give way, do not butcher the people;

sentences.zh: 設若困鬬，則李煜一門，不可加害。

translations.literal: if they resist in desperate battle, still you must not harm Li Yu's household."
translations.idiomatic: and even if they fight to the end, Li Yu and his kin are not to be touched."

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，以知制誥李穆為江南國信使。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Drafting Officer Li Mu was made credentialed envoy to the Jiangnan state.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he appointed drafting officer Li Mu envoy to the Southern Tang court.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，幸迎春苑，登汴隄觀戰艦東下。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiashen, he visited Welcome Spring Garden, ascended the Bian embankment, and watched the warships sail east.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiashen, he went to Welcome Spring Garden, climbed the Bian dike, and watched the fleet head downstream.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，又幸迎春苑，登汴隄觀諸軍習戰，遂幸東水門，發戰櫂東下。

translations.literal: On bingxu, he again visited Welcome Spring Garden, ascended the Bian embankment to watch the various armies drill, then visited East Water Gate and sent the war fleet east.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he returned to Welcome Spring Garden, reviewed troop exercises from the dike, then went to East Water Gate and launched the battle fleet eastward.

sentences.zh: 江南進絹數萬，御衣、金帶、器用數百事。

translations.literal: Jiangnan presented tens of thousands in silk, imperial robes, gold belts, and vessels numbering in the hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Tang sent tens of thousands in silk, court robes, gold belts, and several hundred pieces of ritual ware.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，曹彬等將舟師、步騎發江陵，水陸並進。

translations.literal: On renchen, Cao Bin and the others led the fleet and infantry and cavalry to depart from Jiangling, advancing by land and water together.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Cao Bin's river and land columns left Jiangling in combined advance.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命吳越王錢俶為昇州東南行營招撫制置使。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Wuyue king Qian Chu was made pacification and disposition commissioner of the Southeast Route Army for Shengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou King Qian Chu of Wuyue was named pacification commissioner on the southeastern front against Shengzhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，曹彬收下峽口，獲指揮使王仁震、王宴、錢興。

translations.literal: On jihai, Cao Bin took Xiakou and captured commanders Wang Renzhen, Wang Yan, and Qian Xing.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Cao Bin seized Xiakou and took commanders Wang Renzhen, Wang Yan, and Qian Xing prisoner.

sentences.zh: 閏月己酉，克池州。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on jiyou, Chizhou was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiyou, the army captured Chizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，敗江南軍於銅陵。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Jiangnan forces were defeated at Tongling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Southern Tang army was routed at Tongling.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命宰相、參知政事更知日曆。

translations.literal: On gengshen, an edict ordered the grand councilors and vice grand councilors to rotate in supervising the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he required the chief ministers to take turns overseeing the court calendar.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，彬等拔蕪湖、當塗兩縣，駐軍采石。

translations.literal: On renxu, Bin and the others took the two counties of Wuhu and Dangtu and encamped at Caishi.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Cao Bin captured Wuhu and Dangtu and made camp at Caishi.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔減湖南新製茶。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict reduced the levy on newly manufactured tea in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he cut the tax on Hunan's new tea crop.

sentences.zh: 甲子，薛居正等上新編五代史，賜器幣有差。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Xue Juzheng and others presented the newly compiled History of the Five Dynasties; ritual vessels and silks were bestowed in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Xue Juzheng and his colleagues submitted their new History of the Five Dynasties, and each was rewarded with regalia according to rank.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，彬敗江南軍于采石，擒兵馬部署楊收、都監孫震等千人，為浮梁以濟。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Bin defeated Jiangnan forces at Caishi, captured horse-and-foot deployment commissioner Yang Shou, chief supervisor Sun Zhen, and more than a thousand men, and built a pontoon bridge to cross.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Cao Bin smashed the Southern Tang army at Caishi, taking deployment commissioner Yang Shou, supervisor Sun Zhen, and a thousand soldiers, then threw a floating bridge across the river.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，黥李從善部下及江南水軍一千三百九十人為歸化軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, Li Congshan's followers and one thousand three hundred ninety Jiangnan naval troops were tattooed as the Guhua Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, he branded Li Congshan's retinue and thirteen hundred ninety Southern Tang sailors as the Assimilated Army.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔省劍南、山南等道屬縣主簿。

translations.literal: On jiashen, an edict reduced the county principal clerks of Jiannan, Shannan, and other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he thinned the ranks of county chief clerks in Jiannan, Shannan, and neighboring circuits.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，秦、晉旱，免蒲、陝、晉、絳、同、解六州逋賦，關西諸州免其半。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Qin and Jin suffered drought; overdue taxes in Pu, Shan, Jin, Jiang, Tong, and Jie prefectures were remitted, and western Shaanxi prefectures had half remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai drought afflicted Shaanxi and Shanxi; arrears were forgiven in six prefectures along the middle Yellow River, and western circuits owed only half.

sentences.zh: 己丑，知漢陽軍李恕敗江南水軍於鄂。

translations.literal: On jichou, Hanyang military commissioner Li Shu defeated Jiangnan naval forces at E.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Li Shu, commander at Hanyang, destroyed a Southern Tang fleet on the E River.

sentences.zh: 甲午，曹彬敗江南軍於新林砦。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Cao Bin defeated Jiangnan forces at Xinlin stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Cao Bin routed the Southern Tang at Xinlin stockade.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命知雄州孫全興答涿州修好書。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Xiongzhou prefect Sun Quanxing was ordered to answer Zhuozhou's letter seeking renewed friendship.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he told Xiongzhou prefect Sun Quanxing to reply to Zhuozhou's overture of peace.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大食國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On renyin, the state of Dashi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin envoys from the Arab lands arrived with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，彬敗江南軍於白鷺洲。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiyou, Bin defeated Jiangnan forces at Bailuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiyou, Cao Bin beat the Southern Tang army at Bailuzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命近臣祈雪。

translations.literal: On xinhai, close ministers were ordered to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he sent his inner circle to pray for snow.

sentences.zh: 甲子，吳越王帥兵圍常州，獲其人馬，尋拔利城砦。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the king of Wuyue led troops to besiege Changzhou, captured its men and horses, and soon afterward took Licheng stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the king of Wuyue invested Changzhou, seized men and horses, and shortly after captured Licheng stockade.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，彬敗江南軍於新林港。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Bin defeated Jiangnan forces at Xinlin harbor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Cao Bin won another victory over the Southern Tang at Xinlin harbor.

sentences.zh: 己巳，左拾遺劉祺坐受賂，黥面、杖配沙門島。

translations.literal: On jisi, Left Remonstrator Liu Qi, for accepting bribes, was tattooed on the face, flogged, and banished to Shamen Island.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi left remonstrator Liu Qi was branded on the face, beaten, and exiled to Shamen Island for taking bribes.

sentences.zh: 庚午，北漢寇晉州，守臣武守琦敗之於洪洞。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Northern Han raided Jinzhou; the defending official Wu Shouqi defeated them at Hongdong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Northern Han struck Jinzhou, but defender Wu Shouqi drove them off at Hongdong.

sentences.zh: 壬申，吳越王敗江南軍於常州北界。

translations.literal: On renshen, the king of Wuyue defeated Jiangnan forces on the northern border of Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the king of Wuyue routed the Southern Tang north of Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月甲戌朔，以出師，不御殿。

translations.literal: In year eight, spring, the first month, on jiaxu, the new-moon day, because the army had gone forth he did not preside in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaibao year eight, on the jiaxu new moon in the first month of spring, he withheld court audience while the expedition was in the field.

sentences.zh: 丙子，知池州樊若水敗江南軍於州界；

translations.literal: On bingzi, Chizhou prefect Fan Ruoshui defeated Jiangnan forces at the prefectural border;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Fan Ruoshui, prefect of Chizhou, routed the Southern Tang on his borders;

sentences.zh: 田欽祚敗江南軍於溧水，斬其都統使李雄。

translations.literal: Tian Qinzu defeated Jiangnan forces at Lishui and beheaded their commander-in-chief Li Xiong.
translations.idiomatic: and Tian Qinzu crushed them at Lishui, taking the head of their commander Li Xiong.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，御長春殿，謂宰相曰：「朕觀為臣者比多不能有終，豈忠孝薄而無以享厚福耶？

translations.literal: On yiyou, he presided in Evergreen Hall and said to the grand councilors: "I observe that as ministers you mostly fail to see things through to the end—is it that your loyalty and filial piety are thin, and so you cannot enjoy thick blessings?"
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he held court in Evergreen Hall and told his chief ministers, "Too many of you cannot hold a course to the finish—have you so little loyalty and filial piety that you forfeit lasting favor?"

sentences.zh: 」宰相居正等頓首謝。

translations.literal: The grand councilors Juzheng and the others bowed their heads in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Juzheng and the other ministers kowtowed in acknowledgment.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，曹彬拔昇州城南水砦。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Cao Bin took the southern water stockade of Shengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Cao Bin seized the river fort south of Shengzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，彬敗江南軍於白鷺洲。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guichou, Bin defeated Jiangnan forces at Bailuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guichou, Cao Bin again defeated the Southern Tang at Bailuzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，拔昇州關城。

translations.literal: On yimao, the pass city of Shengzhou was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the outer defenses of Shengzhou fell.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太子中允徐昭文坐抑人售物，除籍。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Crown Prince's Court Officer Xu Zhaowen, for suppressing others' sale of goods, was struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Xu Zhaowen, an associate in the heir's household, was expelled for blocking merchants from selling their wares.

sentences.zh: 甲子，知揚州侯陟敗江南軍於宣化鎮。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Yangzhou prefect Hou Chen defeated Jiangnan forces at Xuanhua town.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Yangzhou prefect Hou Chen routed the Southern Tang at Xuanhua town.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，覆試進士於講武殿，賜王嗣宗等三十一人、諸科紀自成等三十四人及第。

translations.literal: On wuchen, jinshi were re-examined at Lecture-on-Military-Affairs Hall; Wang Sicong and thirty-one others, and Jici Cheng and thirty-four others of various subjects, were granted passage.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the palace held a second jinshi examination in Lecture Hall; thirty-one men led by Wang Sicong and thirty-four specialists including Jici Cheng passed.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，賜王嗣宗等宴錢二十萬。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yiyou, Wang Sicong and the others were granted two hundred thousand in banquet money.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yiyou, he gave Wang Sicong and his fellow graduates two hundred thousand cash for their celebration feast.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命祈雨。

translations.literal: On jichou, an edict ordered prayers for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he ordered rain prayers throughout the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，彬敗江南軍於江中。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Bin defeated Jiangnan forces on the river.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Cao Bin won a river battle against the Southern Tang fleet.

sentences.zh: 己亥，契丹遣使克沙骨慎思以書來講和。

translations.literal: On jihai, the Khitan sent the envoy Keshagusiensi with a letter seeking peace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Khitan dispatched the envoy Keshagusiensi with a letter proposing peace.

sentences.zh: 知潞州藥繼能拔北漢鷹澗堡。

translations.literal: Luzhou prefect Yao Jineng took Northern Han's Yingjian stockade.
translations.idiomatic: At Luzhou, prefect Yao Jineng captured the Northern Han fort at Yingjian.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，召契丹使於講武殿觀習射。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Khitan envoy was summoned to Lecture Hall to watch archery drill.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he invited the Khitan envoy to Lecture Hall to observe target practice.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，遣內侍王繼恩領兵赴昇州。

translations.literal: On renyin, Palace Service Director Wang Jien was dispatched to lead troops to Shengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he sent inner-chamber director Wang Jien with reinforcements to Shengzhou.

sentences.zh: 大食國遣使來朝獻。

translations.literal: The state of Dashi sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from the Arab lands again came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，幸東水磑。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yisi, he visited the East Water Mill.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yisi, he inspected the East Water Mill.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，幸都亭驛閱新戰船。

translations.literal: On guichou, he visited the Capital Pavilion Post to review new warships.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he went to the Capital Pavilion station to inspect newly built warships.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，吳越王拔常州。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the king of Wuyue took Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the king of Wuyue captured Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，彬等敗江南軍於秦淮北。

translations.literal: On renxu, Bin and the others defeated Jiangnan forces north of the Qin-Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Cao Bin and his colleagues routed the Southern Tang north of the Qin-Huai line.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，幸玉津園觀種稻，遂幸講武池觀習水戰。

translations.literal: On wuchen, he visited Yujin Garden to view rice planting, then visited the Lecture Pool to watch naval drill.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he walked the rice plots at Yujin Garden, then watched fleet exercises at the training pool.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔嶺南盜贓滿十貫以上者死。

translations.literal: On gengwu, an edict: in Lingnan, theft and graft reaching ten strings or more were capital crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he decreed death for any Lingnan theft or embezzlement of ten strings of cash or more.

sentences.zh: 幸西水磑。

translations.literal: He visited the West Water Mill.
translations.idiomatic: He also toured the West Water Mill.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申朔，以吳越國王錢俶守太師、尚書令，益食邑。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renshen, the new-moon day, Wuyue king Qian Chu was appointed Grand Preceptor and Director of the Department of State Affairs, with an increase in fief income.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen new moon in the fifth month, King Qian Chu of Wuyue was named Grand Preceptor and chief of the Secretariat, with added fief revenue.

sentences.zh: 知桂陽監張侃發前官隱沒羨銀，追罪兵部郎中董樞、右讚善大夫孔璘，殺之，太子洗馬趙瑜杖配海島；

translations.literal: Guizhou commissioner Zhang Kan uncovered silver concealed by a former official; Military Affairs Bureau Director Dong Shu and Right Supporter of the Heir Kong Lin were pursued for guilt and executed; Crown Prince's Groom Zhao Yu was flogged and banished to a sea island;
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou intendant Zhang Kan exposed silver hoarded by a former magistrate; bureau director Dong Shu and heir-tutor Kong Lin were condemned and put to death; crown prince's groom Zhao Yu was beaten and sent to island exile;

sentences.zh: 侃受賞，遷屯田員外郎。

translations.literal: Kan received a reward and was promoted to Vice Director in the Bureau of Public Works.
translations.idiomatic: Kan was rewarded and promoted to deputy director in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，祈晴。

translations.literal: On xinsi, prayers for clear weather were ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he ordered prayers for fair skies.

sentences.zh: 甲申，江南寧遠軍及沿江砦並降。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Jiangnan's Ningyuan Army and stockades along the river all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the Southern Tang's Ningyuan garrison and every riverside fort came over.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔武岡、長沙等十縣民為賊鹵掠者蠲其逋租，仍給復一年。

translations.literal: On yiyou, an edict remitted overdue rents for the people of ten counties including Wugang and Changsha who had been plundered by bandits, and granted tax relief for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he canceled tax arrears for ten counties such as Wugang and Changsha that bandits had ravaged, and exempted them from levies for a year.

sentences.zh: 甲午，安南都護丁璉遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the Protector-General of Annan, Ding Lian, sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Ding Lian, protector-general of Annan, sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，河決濮州。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Yellow River broke its banks at Pu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Yellow River burst through at Pu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，曹彬等遣使言，敗江南軍於其城下。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renyin, Cao Bin and the others sent envoys reporting that they had defeated Jiangnan forces below the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renyin, Cao Bin's staff reported a victory over the Southern Tang beneath the walls of Shengzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，宋州觀察判官崔絢、錄事參軍馬德休並坐贓棄市。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Songzhou observation commissioner's judge Cui Xuan and registrar Ma Dexiu were both convicted of graft and executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Songzhou judge Cui Xuan and registrar Ma Dexiu were both put to death in the market for corruption.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，河決澶州頓丘。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Yellow River broke its banks at Duanqiu in Cao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the Yellow River breached its dikes at Duanqiu in Cao prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲子，彗出柳，長四丈，辰見東方。

translations.literal: On jiazi, a comet appeared in Willow, four zhang in length, seen in the east at the chen hour.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi a comet four zhang long blazed in the Willow constellation, visible in the eastern sky at dawn.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinwei, the new-moon day, the sun suffered an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei new moon in the seventh month of autumn there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，遣閣門使郝崇信、太常丞呂端使契丹。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Palace Gate Commissioner Hao Chongxin and Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Lü Duan were dispatched as envoys to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he sent gate commissioner Hao Chongxin and sacrifices vice director Lü Duan as envoys to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 癸未，西天東印土王子穰結說囉來朝獻。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the prince of the Western Heaven Eastern India, Rangjieshuoluo, came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Prince Rangjieshuoluo of eastern India came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔吳越王班師。

translations.literal: On jiashen, an edict ordered the king of Wuyue to withdraw his army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he ordered the king of Wuyue to recall his troops.

sentences.zh: 己亥，山後兩林鬼主、懷化將軍勿尼等來朝獻。

translations.literal: On jihai, the ghost chieftains of the Two Forests behind the mountains, the Pacification Army general Wuni, and others came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai tribal chiefs from the Two Forests in the mountain hinterland, including pacification general Wuni, arrived at court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，幸東水磑觀魚，遂幸北園。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yimao, he visited the East Water Dam to view fish, then visited the Northern Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yimao, he went to the East Water Dam to watch the fish, then on to the Northern Garden.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔權停今年貢舉。

translations.literal: On xinyou, an edict provisionally suspended the civil examinations for this year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he ordered the palace examinations held off for the year.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，契丹遣左衛大將軍耶律霸德等致御衣、玉帶、名馬。

translations.literal: On renxu, the Khitan sent Left Guard grand general Yelü Bade and others to present imperial robes, jade belts, and famous horses.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Khitan dispatched Grand General Yelü Bade of the Left Guard with imperial robes, jade belts, and fine horses.

sentences.zh: 西南蕃順化王子若廢等來獻名馬。

translations.literal: The Shunhua prince Ruofei and others of the southwestern tribes came to present famous horses.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ruofei of Shunhua and other southwestern chieftains sent prized horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，丁德裕敗潤州兵於城下。

translations.literal: On guihai, Ding Deyu defeated Jiangnan troops below the walls of Runzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Ding Deyu routed Jiangnan forces at the foot of Runzhou's walls.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，狩近郊，逐兔，馬蹶墜地，因引佩刀刺馬殺之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renshen, he hunted in the near suburbs, chased a hare, and when his horse stumbled and threw him to the ground he drew his belt dagger and stabbed the horse to death.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the ninth month he hunted the suburban preserves, pursued a hare, and when his mount tripped and threw him he killed it with the dagger at his belt.

sentences.zh: 既而悔之，曰：「吾為天下主，輕事畋獵，又何罪馬哉！

translations.literal: Presently he regretted it and said, "I am lord of all under Heaven—why blame the horse for my own light-minded hunting?"
translations.idiomatic: Soon he repented and said, "I hold the realm—what fault was the horse's, that I took a casual hunt so hard?"

sentences.zh: 」自是遂不復獵。

translations.literal: From this time he never hunted again.
translations.idiomatic: After that he gave up hunting altogether.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，潤州降。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Runzhou surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Runzhou came over.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥朔，江南主遣徐鉉、周惟簡來乞緩師。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the jihai new moon, the Jiangnan ruler sent Xu Xuan and Zhou Weijian to beg that the armies be slowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the tenth winter month the Jiangnan king sent Xu Xuan and Zhou Weijian to plead for a halt to the advance.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔郡國令佐察民有孝悌力田、奇材異行或文武可用者遣詣闕。

translations.literal: On xinhai, an edict ordered county magistrates and assistants to identify among the people those filial, fraternal, diligent in farming, of unusual talent or conduct, or usable in civil or military office, and send them to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he commanded local magistrates to forward to the capital anyone noted for filial piety, fraternal duty, farming, rare ability, or promise in civil or military service.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，修西京宮闕。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the palaces of the Western Capital were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi work began on the Western Capital palaces.

sentences.zh: 江南主貢銀五萬兩、絹五萬匹，乞緩師。

translations.literal: The Jiangnan ruler presented fifty thousand taels of silver and fifty thousand bolts of silk, begging that the armies be slowed.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan king sent fifty thousand taels of silver and fifty thousand bolts of silk, again asking that the campaign be slowed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，改潤州鎮海軍節度為鎮江軍節度。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Zhenhai Army circuit commission at Runzhou was renamed the Zhenjiang Army commission.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he redesignated Runzhou's Zhenhai command as the Zhenjiang command.

sentences.zh: 幸晉王北園。

translations.literal: He visited the Prince of Jin's Northern Garden.
translations.idiomatic: He called at the Northern Garden of the Prince of Jin.

sentences.zh: 己未，曹彬遣都虞候劉遇破江南軍於皖口，擒其將朱令贇、王暉。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Cao Bin's chief inspector Liu Yu defeated Jiangnan troops at Wan Mouth and captured their generals Zhu Lingyun and Wang Hui.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Liu Yu, chief inspector under Cao Bin, beat the Jiangnan army at Wan Mouth and took generals Zhu Lingyun and Wang Hui.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，江南主遣徐鉉等再奉表乞緩師，不報。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinwei, the Jiangnan ruler again sent Xu Xuan and others with a memorial begging that the armies be slowed; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinwei, Xu Xuan returned with another plea to slow the armies; the court ignored it.

sentences.zh: 甲申，曹彬夜敗江南軍於城下。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Cao Bin defeated Jiangnan troops below the walls by night.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Cao Bin routed the Jiangnan army under the city walls in a night attack.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以校書郎宋準、殿直邢文慶充賀契丹正旦使。

translations.literal: On bingxu, proofreader Song Zhun and palace attendant Xing Wenqing were appointed envoys to congratulate the Khitan on the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he named proofreader Song Zhun and palace attendant Xing Wenqing envoys to the Khitan New Year court.

sentences.zh: 乙未，曹彬克昇州，俘其國主煜，江南平，凡得州十九、軍三、縣一百八十、戶六十五萬五千六十。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Cao Bin took Shengzhou, captured its ruler Yu, and Jiangnan was pacified; in all there were obtained nineteen prefectures, three army commands, one hundred eighty counties, and six hundred fifty-five thousand sixty households.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Cao Bin seized Shengzhou and took the Jiangnan ruler Li Yu; the south was pacified—nineteen prefectures, three commands, one hundred eighty counties, and six hundred fifty-five thousand sixty households.

sentences.zh: 臨視新龍興寺。

translations.literal: He inspected the new Longxing Temple.
translations.idiomatic: He toured the newly built Longxing Temple.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，幸惠民河觀築堰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengzi, he visited the Huimin Canal to watch dike construction.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the twelfth month he went to the Huimin Canal to inspect the new embankment.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，赦江南，復一歲；

translations.literal: On xinchou, Jiangnan was granted amnesty for one year;
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he pardoned Jiangnan for one year;

sentences.zh: 兵戈所經，二歲。

translations.literal: where the armies had passed, two years.
translations.idiomatic: and for two years in districts the troops had traversed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，三佛齊遣使來獻方物。

translations.literal: On wushen, Srivijaya sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Srivijaya dispatched envoys with regional tribute.

sentences.zh: 己酉，幸龍興寺。

translations.literal: On jiyou, he visited Longxing Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he visited Longxing Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，免開封府諸縣今年秋租十之三。

translations.literal: On xinhai, three-tenths of this year's autumn land tax for the counties of Kaifeng prefecture was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he cut thirty percent from the autumn grain tax owed by Kaifeng's counties.

sentences.zh: 己未，以恩赦侯劉鋹為彭城郡公。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the enfeoffed lord pardoned by grace, Liu Chang, was made Duke of Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Liu Chang, the southern lord spared by the amnesty, was created Duke of Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 甲子，契丹遣使耶律烏正來賀正旦。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the Khitan sent the envoy Yelü Wuzheng to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Khitan envoy Yelü Wuzheng arrived for the New Year felicitation.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，吳越國王乞以長春節朝覲，從之。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the king of Wuyue asked leave to attend court on the Longevity Festival; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Wuyue king petitioned to come to court for the Longevity Festival, and permission was given.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月辛未，御明德門，見李煜於樓下，不用獻俘儀。

translations.literal: In year nine, spring, first month, on xinwei, he presided at the Gate of Illustrious Virtue and received Li Yu below the tower, not using the captive-presentation rite.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaibao year nine, on xinwei in the first month of spring, he held audience at the Gate of Illustrious Virtue and received Li Yu from the tower steps, dispensing with the captive parade.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大赦，減死罪一等。

translations.literal: On renshen, a great amnesty was proclaimed; death sentences were reduced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he proclaimed a general amnesty and commuted capital crimes by one degree.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，封李煜為違命侯，子弟臣僚班爵有差。

translations.literal: On yihai, Li Yu was enfeoffed as Lord Who Disobeys Orders; his sons, brothers, and ministers received ranks in graded order.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he ennobled Li Yu as Lord Who Disobeys Orders and ranked the former king's kin and ministers accordingly.

sentences.zh: 己卯，江南昭武軍節度使留後盧絳焚掠州縣。

translations.literal: On jimao, Lu Jiang, military commissioner of Jiangnan's Zhaowu Army and acting prefect, burned and plundered prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Lu Jiang, regent of the Zhaowu command in Jiangnan, turned bandit and ravaged the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔郊西京。

translations.literal: On gengchen, an edict ordered suburban sacrifice at the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he decreed a suburban offering at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，晉王率文武上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: On guisi, the Prince of Jin led civil and military officials in offering a honorific title; it was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Prince of Jin led the court in urging an exalted title upon him; he refused.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，三上表，不允。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guimao, they submitted the memorial three times; it was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guimao, they pressed the petition three times; he still declined.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以曹彬為樞密使。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Cao Bin was made Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he appointed Cao Bin Commissioner of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命德昭迎勞吳越國王錢俶於宋州。

translations.literal: On xinhai, De Zhao was ordered to go welcome and honor the king of Wuyue, Qian Chu, at Songzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he sent De Zhao to Songzhou to receive and entertain the Wuyue king Qian Chu.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使耶律延寧頁以御衣、玉帶、名馬、散馬、白鶻來賀長春節。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent the envoy Yelü Yanning to present tribute of imperial robes, jade belts, famous horses, remounts, and white cranes in congratulation of the Longevity Festival.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan envoy Yelü Yanning arrived with imperial robes, jade belts, fine horses, remounts, and white cranes for the Longevity Festival.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，吳越王奏內客省使丁德裕貪很，貶房州刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao, the king of Wuyue memorialized that Inner Palace envoy Ding Deyu was greedy and harsh; he was demoted to prefect of Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Qian Chu accused Inner Palace envoy Ding Deyu of rapacity; the court banished Ding to Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，觀禮賢宅。

translations.literal: On dingsi, he visited the Lodge for Honoring the Worthy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he toured the Lodge for Honoring the Worthy.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以盧多遜為吏部侍郎，仍參知政事。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Lu Duoxun was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel while continuing as participant in governance.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Lu Duoxun was named Vice Director of Personnel and kept his seat on the council.

sentences.zh: 己未，吳越國王錢俶偕子惟濬等朝於崇德殿，進銀絹以萬計。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the king of Wuyue Qian Chu, together with his son Weijun and others, attended audience in the Hall of Exalted Virtue and presented silver and silk counted by the ten thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Qian Chu of Wuyue came before the Hall of Exalted Virtue with his son Weijun and a train of kin, offering silver and silk by the myriad.

sentences.zh: 賜俶衣帶鞍馬，遂以禮賢宅居之，宴於長安殿。

translations.literal: Chu was granted robes, belt, saddle, and horse, then lodged in the Lodge for Honoring the Worthy and feasted in the Hall of Lasting Peace.
translations.idiomatic: He dressed Chu in court regalia, lodged him at the Lodge for Honoring the Worthy, and held a feast in the Hall of Lasting Peace.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，錢俶進賀平昇州銀絹、乳香、吳綾、紬綿、錢茶、犀象、香藥，皆億萬計。

translations.literal: On renxu, Qian Chu presented silver, silk, frankincense, Wu brocade, floss silk, tea money, rhinoceros horn, ivory, and aromatics in congratulation of the pacification of Shengzhou, all reckoned in the hundred millions.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Qian Chu sent congratulations for the fall of Shengzhou—silver, silk, frankincense, Wu gauze, floss, tea money, rhinoceros, ivory, and spices beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 甲子，召晉王、吳越國王並其子等射於苑中，俶進御衣、壽星、通犀帶及金器。

translations.literal: On jiazi, he summoned the Prince of Jin, the king of Wuyue, and their sons to shoot in the park; Chu presented imperial robes, a Longevity star image, a rhinoceros-horn belt, and gold vessels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he called the Prince of Jin, Qian Chu, and their sons to the archery ground; Chu gave imperial robes, a Longevity icon, a rhinoceros belt, and gold wares.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，幸禮賢宅，賜俶金器及銀絹倍萬。

translations.literal: On dingmao, he visited the Lodge for Honoring the Worthy and bestowed on Chu gold vessels and silver and silk in redoubled myriads.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he called again at the Lodge for Honoring the Worthy and doubled the gold, silver, and silk he gave Chu.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，俶進助南郊銀絹、乳香以萬計。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jisi, Chu presented silver, silk, and frankincense for the southern suburban sacrifice, counted by the ten thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the third month Chu sent myriad-fold gifts of silver, silk, and frankincense toward the southern suburban rite.

sentences.zh: 庚午，賜俶劍履上殿，詔書不名。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Chu was granted sword and shoes for audience in the hall and an edict that his name need not be spoken in full.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he allowed Chu sword and shoes in the throne hall and decreed that memorials might omit his personal name.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以皇子德芳為檢校太保、貴州防禦使，中書侍郎、同平章事沈義倫為大內都部署，右衛大將軍王仁贍權判留司、三司兼知開封府事。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the imperial son De Fang was made Acting Grand Guardian and Gui prefecture defense commissioner; Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Grand Councilor Shen Yilun was made chief commissioner of the inner palace; Right Guard grand general Wang Renzan was made acting commissioner for the capital and concurrently controller of the Three Bureaus and acting prefect of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Prince De Fang became Acting Grand Guardian and defense commissioner of Gui; Shen Yilun, vice director and associate councilor, took charge of the inner palace; Wang Renzan of the Right Guard governed the capital in lieu, ran the Three Bureaus, and acted as Kaifeng prefect.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸西京。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he set out for the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he departed for Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 己卯，次鞏縣，拜安陵，號慟隕絕者久之。

translations.literal: On jimao, he halted at Gong county, paid respects at the Anling tomb, and for a long while wailed until he collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he stopped at Gong, bowed at the Anling tomb of his forebears, and keened until he fell senseless.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，賜河南府民今年田租之半，奉陵戶復一年。

translations.literal: On gengchen, half of this year's field tax for the people of Henan prefecture was remitted, and tomb-guard households were exempted for another year.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he halved the year's land tax for Henan and gave the tomb-guard households another year free of levy.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，至洛陽。

translations.literal: On xinsi, he arrived at Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he entered Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大雨，分命近臣詣諸祠廟祈晴。

translations.literal: On gengyin, heavy rain fell; close ministers were separately ordered to pray for clear weather at the various shrines and temples.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin torrential rain fell and he sent intimates to every shrine and temple to pray for sun.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，幸廣化寺，開無畏三藏塔。

translations.literal: On xinmao, he visited Guanghua Temple and opened the stupa of the Fearless Tripitaka master.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he went to Guanghua Temple and opened the pagoda of the Fearless Tripitaka master.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，雨霽。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jihai, the rain cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on jihai in the fourth month, the skies broke.

sentences.zh: 庚子，有事圜丘，迴御五鳳樓大赦，十惡、故殺者不原，貶降責免者量移敘用，諸流配及逋欠悉放，諸官未贈恩者悉覃賞。

translations.literal: On gengzi, he performed the suburban rite at the Round Mound; returning, he held a great amnesty at the Five Phoenix Tower. The ten abominations and deliberate homicide were not pardoned; those demoted, degraded, fined, or dismissed were moved and reemployed as appropriate; all exiles and arrears were released; and every official not yet granted favor was broadly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he offered at the Round Mound, then proclaimed a great amnesty from the Five Phoenix Tower—sparing neither the ten capital crimes nor deliberate murder, but restoring demoted and dismissed men where fit, freeing exiles and debtors, and showering rewards on officials still unrewarded.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大宴，賜親王、近臣、列校襲衣、金帶、鞍馬、器幣有差。

translations.literal: On renyin, a great banquet was held; princes, close ministers, and commanders were given robes, gold belts, saddles, horses, and vessels in graded measure.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he held a great feast and gave princes, intimates, and field commanders graded gifts of robes, gold belts, horses, and wares.

sentences.zh: 丙午，駕還。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the imperial carriage returned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the court turned homeward.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上至自洛。

translations.literal: On xinhai, he arrived from Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he came back from Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，曹翰拔江州，屠之，擒牙校宋德明、胡則等。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Cao Han took Jiangzhou, slaughtered the city, and captured the junior officers Song Deming, Hu Ze, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Cao Han stormed Jiangzhou, put the populace to the sword, and seized officers Song Deming and Hu Ze.

sentences.zh: 詔益晉王食邑，光美、德昭並加開府儀同三司，德芳益食邑，薛居正、沈義倫加光祿大夫，樞密使曹彬、宣徽北院使潘美加特進，吳越國王錢俶益食邑，內外文武臣僚咸進階封。

translations.literal: An edict increased the Prince of Jin's fief; Guangyi and De Zhao were both made Acting Palace Equerry of the First Rank; De Fang's fief was increased; Xue Juzheng and Shen Yilun were made Grand Masters of Splendid Happiness; Military Affairs Commissioner Cao Bin and Northern Court commissioner Pan Mei were made Special Advance; the king of Wuyue Qian Chu's fief was increased; and civil and military officials within and without were all advanced in rank and fief.
translations.idiomatic: He enlarged the Prince of Jin's domain, made Guangyi and De Zhao acting first-rank equerries, added to De Fang's fief, raised Xue Juzheng and Shen Yilun to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, advanced Cao Bin and Pan Mei to Special Advance, increased Qian Chu's fief, and promoted the whole civil and military roster.

sentences.zh: 己未，著令旬假為休沐。

translations.literal: On jiwei, it was established in statute that the ten-day leave cycle should be rest and bathing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he codified the ten-day court recess as official rest days.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大食國王珂黎拂遣使蒲希密來獻方物。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the king of the Dashi state, Abu al-Abbas, sent the envoy Pu Ximi to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Abbasid caliph Abu al-Abbas sent Pu Ximi with regional tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，幸東水磑，遂幸飛龍院，觀漁金水河。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jisi, he visited the East Water Dam, then visited Flying Dragon Hall and watched fishing on the Jinshui River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jisi, he went to the East Water Dam, then to Flying Dragon Hall to watch fishing on the Jinshui.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣司勳員外郎和峴往江南路採訪。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Merit Evaluation vice director He Yan was dispatched to tour and investigate the Jiangnan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he sent Merit Evaluation vice director He Yan to tour the Jiangnan circuit.

sentences.zh: 殺盧絳。

translations.literal: Lu Jiang was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jiang was put to death.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，幸講武池，遂幸玉津園觀稼。

translations.literal: On gengchen, he visited the Lecture-on-Military-Affairs Pool, then visited Jade Ford Garden to view the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he went to the Lecture Pool, then to Jade Ford Garden to inspect the grain.

sentences.zh: 宋州大風，壞城樓、官民舍幾五千間。

translations.literal: At Songzhou a great wind destroyed city towers and official and private dwellings, nearly five thousand rooms in all.
translations.idiomatic: A gale at Songzhou wrecked the gate towers and nearly five thousand government and private buildings.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以閣門副使田守奇等充賀契丹生辰使。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Deputy Commissioner of the Gate Tian Shouqi and others were appointed envoys to congratulate the Khitan on the imperial birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Tian Shouqi, deputy commissioner of the gate, and his party were named envoys to the Khitan birthday court.

sentences.zh: 晉州以北漢嵐、石、憲三州巡檢使王洪武等來獻。

translations.literal: Patrol inspectors Wang Hongwu and others of Northern Han's Lan, Shi, and Xian prefectures north of Jinzhou came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hongwu and other Northern Han patrol inspectors from Lan, Shi, and Xian north of Jin came over.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，步至晉王邸，命作機輪，輓金水河注邸中為池。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengzi, he walked to the Prince of Jin's residence and ordered a waterwheel built to draw the Jinshui into the compound and form a pool.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the sixth month he walked to the Prince of Jin's mansion and had a wheel rigged to lift Jinshui water into a new pool.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，吳越王進銀、絹、綿以倍萬計。

translations.literal: On guimao, the king of Wuyue presented silver, silk, and floss in redoubled myriads.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Wuyue king sent silver, silk, and floss counted in redoubled myriads.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，熒惑入南斗。

translations.literal: On yimao, the Fire Star entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Mars entered the mansions of the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，幸晉王第觀新池。
